task: Convert apps/web into an installable iOS PWA: home-screen icon, standalone display, offline app-shell caching, and an update-available prompt — no App Store distribution
acceptanceCriteria: Four PNG icons generated at the correct sizes, opaque, on-brand, under 40KB each
Manifest resolves with all icons (any + maskable) and no 404s
Service worker precaches the built app shell but never /api
Offline reload of a previously visited page still renders the shell
An authenticated /api call is always served from the network, never the service worker
Update-available prompt renders only when a new build is waiting, refresh reloads on the new worker, dismiss hides without losing the pending update
Existing dark-mode pre-paint script in index.html stays byte-identical and last in <head>
apps/api and existing web tests are unaffected
blastRadius: PWA install/offline behavior on iOS Safari
existing authenticated API request flow (must never be cached by the SW)
existing dark-mode pre-paint flash prevention in index.html
contracts: generate-pwa-icons.mjs is a manual, non-build script — never wired into pnpm build
